note: How the pinned CLI bundles a codebase script, reproduced through esbuild's Go API at 0.28.0 (bundle.BuildCodebase, milestone C2b). Each case is a whole sync folder with one codebases entry, built by bundle.Build; cases that run call the built module on the pinned Bun. Which runtime a CommonJS bundle runs on is deviation D13, whose cases (Node against the Bun harness) are in steps/bun/d13.yaml.

cases.title: an absent format builds CommonJS
cases.rest_in: the step suite (steps/bun/d13.yaml) runs the bundle on Node and on the Bun harness (D13)
cases.note: The module is scripts/bun/<id>.cjs, in esbuild's CommonJS shape, with the export-name annotation Node's loader reads.

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
folder.f/cb/runtime.ts: export function main() { return typeof (globalThis as any).Bun; }

cases.title: format: esm builds ES module output, which runs on Bun

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    format: esm
folder.f/cb/runtime.ts: export function main() { return typeof (globalThis as any).Bun; }

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    define: {"__MODE__": "\"lite\""}
folder.f/cb/mode.ts:
declare const __MODE__: string;
export function main() { return __MODE__; }

cases.title: inject supplies a free identifier
cases.note: Inject paths resolve against the sync root, the CLI's working directory. The injected file is a script of the entry too, built on its own.

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    inject: ["f/cb/shim.ts"]
folder.f/cb/inject.ts:
declare const answer: number;
export function main() { return answer; }

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    loader: {".txt": "text"}
folder.f/cb/text.ts:
import note from "./note.txt";
export function main() { return note; }

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    banner: {js: "globalThis.__banner = 1;"}
folder.f/cb/banner.ts: export function main() { return (globalThis as any).__banner; }

cases.title: npm packages are inlined from the folder's node_modules, with no lock
cases.note: Packages are bundled (packages: bundle, WR-47), and a codebase script has no lock (SY-8), so the build installs nothing and asks for no lock.

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
folder.f/cb/pkg.ts:
import { tag } from "fixture-cb";
export function main() { return tag; }

cases.title: the signatures of a codebase script's exports are parsed from its source
cases.note: Windmill parses the script's content, which the push sends with the bundle (SY-8); the Bun helper's parse records it, as for any Bun script: Date marking (WR-8), a destructured parameter as anonN (WR-7), no parameters for an arrow export (WR-6).

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
folder.f/cb/sig.ts:
export async function main(a: number, when: Date, { x }: { x: string }) { return a; }
export const other = (y: string) => y;

cases.title: a format other than cjs or esm is refused
cases.note: WR-47 names only cjs and esm; the CLI passes any other value to esbuild, and Windmill runs every bundle without .esm as CommonJS on Node.

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    format: iife

cases.title: exports an entry re-exports with export * get signatures, empty unless the entry declares them
cases.note: The metadata covers the bundle's exports, which esbuild links through export *, so a re-exported main is callable (c2b review 1, finding 2). Windmill parses only the script's content (WR-6, WR-7): a function the entry declares gets its parameters, and one it re-exports gets an empty list, never the dependency's.

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
folder.f/cb/lib.ts:
export function main(x: number) { return x + 1; }
export function other() { return "other"; }
folder.f/cb/wild.ts:
export * from "./lib";
export function own(a: number, when: Date) { return a; }

cases.title: export names are read with the build's own resolution, so a re-exported module that imports a host-provided module is signed
cases.note: The host-provided module imports the bun built-in, which esbuild's node platform cannot resolve; the codebase bundle reaches it only through its shim. The export names are read from a build with the same plugin, so main, which export * brings in, is signed (c2b review 2, finding 2).

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
folder.f/shared/ver.ts:
import { version } from "bun";
export function read() { return version; }
folder.f/cb/hlib.ts:
import { read } from "../shared/ver";
export function main() { return [42, typeof read()]; }
